raw.details:
Introduction

HackKro presents CodeClash 1.0, a multi-round competitive coding battle hosted on the Unstop platform. Designed for both aspiring programmers and seasoned problem solvers, CodeClash 1.0 tests foundational logic, algorithm design, and core programming proficiency. Compete nationwide, solve challenging problems, and push your limits.

Event Details

Detail Information
Event Name CodeClash 1.0
Organized By HackKro
Start Date 30th September 2026
Mode Online (via Unstop)
Eligibility Open to all undergraduate & postgraduate students (all streams & years)
Registration Fee Free

Event Structure & Rounds

Round 1: Preliminary Quiz (MCQ Round)

  • Platform: Unstop Assessment

  • Duration: 30 Minutes

  • Format: 30 Multiple Choice Questions

  • Syllabus: Core Programming Fundamentals (C++, Java, Python), Data Structures Basics, Aptitude & Logical Reasoning

  • Evaluation: Based on score and completion speed. Top performers qualify for Round 2.

Round 2: Java Coding Sprint (Intermediate Challenge)

  • Platform: Unstop Coding Arena

  • Primary Language: Java

  • Format: 2–3 Algorithmic Coding Problems (Easy to Medium)

  • Syllabus: Arrays, Strings, Hashing, Recursion, Object-Oriented Principles, Basic Data Structures

  • Evaluation: Automated test-case execution (Correctness, Time Complexity, and Space Complexity). Top qualifiers advance to the Final Round.

Round 3: Java Master Clash (Grand Finale)

  • Platform: Unstop Coding Arena

  • Primary Language: Java

  • Format: 2 Complex Problem-Solving Challenges (Medium to Hard)

  • Syllabus: Advanced Data Structures (Trees, Graphs, Heaps), Dynamic Programming, Greedy Algorithms, System Optimization

  • Evaluation: Full test-suite pass rate, execution efficiency, and code quality.

Rewards & Certificates

  • Top Performers (Winners): Winner Certificate + Feature on HackKro channels

  • Finalists: Certificate of Merit for reaching the final rounds

  • All Active Participants: Official Certificate of Participation

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all registered undergraduate and postgraduate students nationwide.

  • Participation is strictly individual (no teams).

  • Accurate selection of academic year and college details during registration is mandatory.

Rules & Code of Conduct

  • Official Platform: All submissions must be made exclusively through the designated Unstop contest environment.

  • Fair Play: Strictly zero tolerance for plagiarism, AI-assisted tools, secondary devices, or unauthorized tab switching.

  • Single Account Policy: Duplicate accounts or multiple entries will result in immediate disqualification.

  • Authority: In all matters regarding qualification, scoring, and edge cases, the decision of Team HackKro is final and binding.

Judging & Tie-Breaking Criteria

  • Round 1 (MCQ): Highest score wins. Ties broken by the fastest submission timestamp.

  • Rounds 2 & 3 (Java Coding): Score determined by passed test cases (visible + hidden edge cases). Ties broken by cumulative time taken and memory consumption.
